subject: Renewal discussion: elevate hosted commit + rate band restructure
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kayla Ortiz <kayla.ortiz@novascale.ai>, procurement@novascale.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion: elevate hosted commit + rate band restructure

Kayla / NovaScale procurement team —

Hope you had a good kickoff to the week. Per our conversation last week, I wanted to put a concrete proposal on the table for your upcoming renewal (term starts 2028-07-01). We reviewed your April usage and the forecast you shared — looks like steady growth across embedding-heavy queries and chat completion spikes during peak hours.

Quick summary of what we’re proposing: 
- Monthly committed tokens: increase from 12M -> 20M (effective at renewal)
- New tiered unit pricing: two-step rate bands to protect against burst traffic (base rate for first 20M, excess rate at reduced step)
- Soft throttle window: preserve latency SLOs with controlled burst credits (you asked for predictable behaviour during launches)

I attached an April usage export and a draft addendum with pricing bands and suggested SLO/KPI language. If you’re open, I’d like to schedule a 30-min call to run the mutual action plan and procurement steps (we can include legal/finance). Proposed times: Thu 5/9 10:00am PT or Fri 5/10 1:00pm PT.

Open questions on our side that will help firm up the final SOW:
- Do you want the new commit to be monthly recurring or a 12-month prepay?
- Will you require private deployment for any regulated workloads in the next 6 months (this affects our on-prem quoting)?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a formal addendum and a HubSpot link for signoff.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com]
[Attachment: NovaScale-usage-apr2028.pdf (PDF)]

From: Kayla Ortiz <kayla.ortiz@novascale.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@novascale.ai, Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@novascale.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 May 2028 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: elevate hosted commit + rate band restructure

Jordan —

Thanks for the summary and for sending the usage export. Initial reactions: the proposed monthly commit increase to 20M makes sense given our Q2 launch cadence, but procurement will want to see clear unit cost improvements as usage scales. A couple items from our side: 

- Can you model the expected per-token cost at 20M vs 30M so we understand marginal economics?
- During our peak (weekday launches) we saw latency spikes; need reassurance on SLOs and an ops playbook if we hit 95th percentile bursts.
- Procurement prefers 12-month prepaid commitments for budget predictability, but we may ask for a limited true-up clause if usage exceeds 35M in any month.

We can do Thu 5/9 at 10am PT. Please include whoever owns SRE/OPS recommendations on your side (Ben?). Also will procurement want any SOC2 artifacts before executing? They typically ask.

—Kayla
VP Product, NovaScale
[Attachment: none]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kayla Ortiz <kayla.ortiz@novascale.ai>, Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@novascale.ai>, procurement@novascale.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: elevate hosted commit + rate band restructure — call notes and proposed addendum

Thanks for the quick reply — great to get the call on the calendar. Notes from our 10:00am PT discussion:

- Agreement in principle to move to a 20M monthly committed token plan with an option to scale to 30M if monthly true-up thresholds are met.
- NovaScale prefers 12-month prepay for budget predictability; Redwood can support prepay with a 6-month partial refund window if total usage remains under the committed baseline (we captured the true-up ask).
- Ben walked through our ops playbook: automatic prefix caching, burst credits (500k tokens per day for the first 7 days of a launch) and a ramp-rate throttle to keep 95th p99 latency under target. Ben flagged that during extreme spikes we can automatically route to a cheaper model variant with fallbacks.

Attached is the proposed addendum (Redwood-Proposed-Addendum-NS.docx) and a short cost modeling sheet (NovaScale-Commit-Summary-2028.xlsx). The addendum includes language for: committed volume, unit pricing per band, soft-throttle behavior, true-up mechanics, and rollback/early-termination credits.

Pricing highlights (summary table is in the doc):
- 20M monthly commit (12-month prepay): base unit price $0.00110/token equivalent (embeddings normalized)
- Excess usage up to 30M: stepped reduced rate $0.00095/token for the band 20M-30M
- Burst credits apply before excess billing for launch windows (first 7 days of a product release)
- One-time onboarding credit applied at execution: $5,000 to offset migration/ops time

Action items: 
- Jordan to share finalized addendum + HubSpot deal record (today)
- NovaScale to confirm prepay vs monthly billing preference and any required SOC2 evidence for procurement (Kayla/Ethan)
- Marissa to approve any contractual discount beyond standard rate (Marissa, can you confirm if we can offer a 10% concession on the base unit price for strategic partnership?)

Attachments: Redwood-Proposed-Addendum-NS.docx, NovaScale-Commit-Summary-2028.xlsx

Best,
Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: elevate hosted commit + rate band restructure — discount approval?

Jordan / Ben —

I reviewed the proposed pricing and the strategic language in the addendum. We’re comfortable offering a one-time 10% concession on the base unit price for the 12-month prepaid path given NovaScale’s rising usage and the reference-value of the partnership. Conditions: 

1) Commit executes by 2028-06-15 and term begins 2028-07-01. 
2) NovaScale signs the addendum and the associated SOW via DocuSign. 
3) If NovaScale moves to private/on-prem in the next 6 months, we will re-evaluate unit pricing (standard re-quote applies).

I’ll prepare an internal credit approval note and loop legal on the final addendum language. Jordan, can you confirm you’ll update the HubSpot deal record with the concession and attach the addendum? Ben, please pull the p99 telemetry samples for Apr/May to include in the SLO appendix.

Marissa
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: elevate hosted commit + rate band restructure — final confirmation

Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks — that all sounds reasonable and I appreciate the flexibility. We will: 

- Proceed with the 12-month prepaid 20M commit (target execution by 2028-06-10).
- Accept the 10% concession on base unit price as documented.
- Require SOC2 Type II report and network diagram for procurement (Ethan will upload to our vendor portal).

Please send the final addendum with the concession baked in and the DocuSign link. We’ll try to turn this in the next 2–3 business days.

Kayla Ortiz
VP Product, NovaScale
[Attachment: none]
